title: audit detail read.stream.terminal
description: detail of audit rows with action read.stream.terminal: a browser watches the terminal output of a session through the live channel (one row per watched session of an opened stream, ADR-063 section 3). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
